panels.title: Переходы по QR
panels.description: Визиты по QR-ссылке и число разных кодов за выбранный период.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE qr_hash IS NOT NULL) AS "Визиты по QR",
       count(DISTINCT qr_hash) AS "Разные QR"
FROM analytics_events
WHERE kind = 'visit' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)

panels.title: Активное время
panels.description: Только время на видимой вкладке. Медиана считается по визитам с замером в выбранном периоде.

targets.rawSql:
WITH visits AS (
    SELECT visit_id, sum(duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS seconds
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE kind = 'active_time' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
    GROUP BY visit_id
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds) AS "Медиана"
FROM visits

panels.title: Просмотры товаров
panels.description: Каждый товар засчитывается один раз за визит. Учитываются бальзам на первом экране и карточки подборки.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT (visit_id, target)) AS "Товары × визиты"
FROM analytics_events
WHERE kind = 'product_impression' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)

panels.title: Клики на сайт РИВ ГОШ
panels.description: Клики на внешний сайт, включая ссылки на товары и каталог магазинов.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Клики"
FROM analytics_events
WHERE kind = 'site_click' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)

panels.title: Клики на приложение
panels.description: Переходы по кнопкам App Store, Google Play и RuStore.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Клики"
FROM analytics_events
WHERE kind = 'app_click' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)

panels.title: Посещения по дням
panels.description: День начинается в 00:00 по Москве. Разные QR считаются отдельно для каждого дня.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS start_at, $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS end_at
), days AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        date_trunc('day', start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
        date_trunc('day', end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
        interval '1 day'
    ) AS day
    FROM bounds
), daily AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('day', recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AS day, count(*) AS visits,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE qr_hash IS NOT NULL) AS qr_visits,
           count(DISTINCT qr_hash) AS unique_qr
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE kind = 'visit' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT greatest(days.day AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow', bounds.start_at) AS time,
       coalesce(visits, 0) AS "Все визиты",
       coalesce(qr_visits, 0) AS "Визиты по QR",
       coalesce(unique_qr, 0) AS "Разные QR"
FROM days CROSS JOIN bounds
LEFT JOIN daily USING (day)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Активное время по дням
panels.description: Медиана времени на видимой вкладке по визитам с замером в этот день.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS start_at, $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS end_at
), days AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        date_trunc('day', start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
        date_trunc('day', end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
        interval '1 day'
    ) AS day
    FROM bounds
), visit_time AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('day', recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AS day, visit_id, sum(duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS seconds
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE kind = 'active_time' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
    GROUP BY 1, visit_id
), daily AS (
    SELECT day, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds) AS median_seconds
    FROM visit_time
    GROUP BY day
)
SELECT greatest(days.day AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow', bounds.start_at) AS time, median_seconds AS "Медиана"
FROM days CROSS JOIN bounds
LEFT JOIN daily USING (day)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Просмотры товаров по дням
panels.description: Каждый товар считается один раз за визит в пределах дня для каждого типа события.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS start_at, $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS end_at
), days AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        date_trunc('day', start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
        date_trunc('day', end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
        interval '1 day'
    ) AS day
    FROM bounds
), daily AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('day', recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AS day,
           count(DISTINCT (visit_id, target)) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'product_impression') AS impressions,
           count(DISTINCT (visit_id, target)) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'product_open') AS opens
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE kind IN ('product_impression', 'product_open') AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT greatest(days.day AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow', bounds.start_at) AS time,
       coalesce(impressions, 0) AS "Показали",
       coalesce(opens, 0) AS "Открыли"
FROM days CROSS JOIN bounds
LEFT JOIN daily USING (day)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Исходящие клики по дням
panels.description: Клики на сайт РИВ ГОШ и на кнопки магазинов приложений.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS start_at, $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS end_at
), days AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        date_trunc('day', start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
        date_trunc('day', end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
        interval '1 day'
    ) AS day
    FROM bounds
), daily AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('day', recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AS day,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'site_click') AS site_clicks,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'app_click') AS app_clicks
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE kind IN ('site_click', 'app_click') AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT greatest(days.day AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow', bounds.start_at) AS time,
       coalesce(site_clicks, 0) AS "Сайт РИВ ГОШ",
       coalesce(app_clicks, 0) AS "Магазины приложений"
FROM days CROSS JOIN bounds
LEFT JOIN daily USING (day)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Товары в подборке
panels.description: Показ означает, что хотя бы половина карточки была видна 750 мс. Открытие — отдельный просмотр страницы товара. Показатели считаются по уникальным визитам.

targets.rawSql:
WITH products (id, label) AS (VALUES
    ('eva', 'Eva Mosaic Cherry Lip Balm · подарок'),
    ('holika', 'Holika Holika Holipop Water Tint'),
    ('celimax', 'Celimax Dual Barrier Creamy Toner'),
    ('tangle', 'Tangle Teezer The Wet Detangler'),
    ('influence', 'Influence Beauty Lunar Highlighter')
)
SELECT products.label AS "Товар",
       count(DISTINCT events.visit_id) FILTER (WHERE events.kind = 'product_impression') AS "Увидели",
       count(DISTINCT events.visit_id) FILTER (WHERE events.kind = 'product_open') AS "Открыли"
FROM products
LEFT JOIN analytics_events AS events ON events.target = products.id
    AND $__timeFilter(events.recorded_at)
GROUP BY products.id, products.label
ORDER BY "Увидели" DESC, products.label

panels.title: Магазины приложений
panels.description: Клики и число визитов, в которых была нажата кнопка магазина.

targets.rawSql:
WITH stores (id, label) AS (VALUES
    ('app_store', 'App Store'),
    ('google_play', 'Google Play'),
    ('rustore', 'RuStore')
)
SELECT stores.label AS "Магазин", count(events.id) AS "Клики",
       count(DISTINCT events.visit_id) AS "Визиты с кликом"
FROM stores
LEFT JOIN analytics_events AS events ON events.target = stores.id
    AND events.kind = 'app_click' AND $__timeFilter(events.recorded_at)
GROUP BY stores.id, stores.label
ORDER BY "Клики" DESC, stores.label

panels.title: Визиты и замеры
panels.description: Размер выборки за период. Повторное открытие страницы в рамках визита даёт одну запись о визите.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'visit') AS "Все визиты",
       count(DISTINCT visit_id) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'active_time') AS "С замером времени"
FROM analytics_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
